summary:
ASTRAFORGE – Build. Strategize. Explore.

ASTRAFORGE is an interactive multiplayer space mission simulation game that transforms the complexity of space exploration into an exciting engineering adventure. Designed for up to four players, it allows participants to become space mission designers, creating their own missions to destinations such as Earth orbit, the Moon, and Mars.

Players must strategically select spacecraft components, scientific instruments, power systems, communication equipment, fuel tanks, and launch vehicles while managing limited budgets, mass, power, and mission requirements. Unexpected in-game events challenge their decisions, making every mission a unique experience.

ASTRAFORGE addresses the challenge by providing a simple, engaging, and interactive platform to simulate the key decisions involved in planning a space mission. It makes aerospace engineering concepts easier to understand through hands-on gameplay rather than theory alone.

Why is it important? Because every great space mission begins with an idea, careful planning, and smart engineering. ASTRAFORGE inspires the next generation of explorers and engineers by turning learning into competition, creativity, and discovery.

Design. Build. Launch. Explore. The universe is your challenge!
details:
ASTRAFORGE – Build. Strategize. Explore.

ASTRAFORGE is an interactive multiplayer space mission simulation game that allows up to four players to design and plan their own space missions to destinations such as Earth orbit, the Moon, and Mars.

The game works by allowing players to select spacecraft components, scientific instruments, power systems, communication equipment, fuel tanks, and launch vehicles. Players must manage limited budgets, spacecraft mass, power consumption, fuel requirements, and mission objectives to build a successful mission. Unexpected challenges make the gameplay more interesting and encourage strategic decision-making.

Benefits:
ASTRAFORGE makes learning about space exploration and aerospace engineering simple, interactive, and enjoyable. It helps players understand spacecraft systems, mission planning, resource management, teamwork, and problem-solving through hands-on gameplay.

Intended Impact:
The project aims to inspire students and young people to develop an interest in space science, aerospace engineering, and technology. It provides an engaging educational experience that makes complex space exploration concepts easier to understand.

Creativity and Innovation:
ASTRAFORGE combines engineering concepts with multiplayer gaming. Instead of simply reading about space missions, players can independently design spacecraft, make decisions, manage resources, and experience different mission challenges. Every mission can have a different outcome depending on the player's choices.

Factors Considered:
Our team considered user-friendliness, educational value, realistic basic mission requirements, limited resources, spacecraft mass, power consumption, fuel management, mission objectives, multiplayer interaction, and accessibility for beginners.
